validated_results.title: Nitric oxide synthase (eNOS4a/b) gene polymorphism is associated with tumor recurrence and progression in superficial bladder cancer cases.
validated_results.reason: Nitric oxide here is a plasma oxidative-stress metabolite measured alongside an eNOS gene polymorphism, not a nutritional exposure, and results concern recurrence and progression rather than a dietary exposure effect on incidence.

validated_results.title: Update on evidence that support a role of solar ultraviolet-B irradiance in reducing cancer risk.
validated_results.reason: This article is a narrative review of ecological and observational evidence on solar UVB/vitamin D and cancer risk, not an original human study.

sample_size.excerpt: Plasma concentrations of 25(OH)D(3) in 1125 cases with UBC and 1028 control subjects were determined by a chemiluminescence immunoassay.
sample_size.location: abstract, methods; total_n derived from reported group counts 1125 + 1028 = 2153

cases.excerpt: Plasma concentrations of 25(OH)D(3) in 1125 cases with UBC and 1028 control subjects were determined by a chemiluminescence immunoassay.

effect_size.excerpt: A statistically significantly increased risk of UBC was observed among subjects presenting the lowest concentrations of 25(OH)D(3) (OR(adj) = 1.83; 95% CI = 1.19 to 2.82; P = .006), showing a dose-response effect (P (trend) = .004).

confidence_interval.excerpt: A statistically significantly increased risk of UBC was observed among subjects presenting the lowest concentrations of 25(OH)D(3) (OR(adj) = 1.83; 95% CI = 1.19 to 2.82; P = .006), showing a dose-response effect (P (trend) = .004).

validated_results.title: Dietary intake of nitrate and nitrite and risk of renal cell carcinoma in the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study.
validated_results.reason: The cohort quantified dietary nitrate and nitrite intake, including nitrite from processed meats, rather than processed meat consumption itself, so no processed meat intake estimate for renal cell carcinoma is reported.
